status: PHASE 3D PROVISIONAL ELEVATOR / TRIM TRADE / NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION OR FLIGHT CLEARANCE

elevator.chord_fraction_basis: PDR-0.1 provisional elevator approximately 30% horizontal-tail chord; not baseline-promoted

trim_screen.near_stall_note: 8.0 m/s is intentionally excluded from the first VLM trim trade because it is too close to the current analytical stall estimate for a linear thin-surface control-authority screen.

boundary: Phase 3D will compare provisional elevator geometry and trim authority; it does not promote a horizontal tail or elevator.
Control-surface parameter names and symmetric gain conventions are probed against the pinned OpenVSP 3.51.3 API before the full trade is generated.
VLM control authority is a linear/pre-stall computational screen and does not establish hinge moments, structural adequacy, control feel, stall behavior or flight clearance.
Near-stall trim, propeller slipstream, fuselage interference and aeroelastic control effectiveness are deferred.
